description: Chroma HTTP-server advisories deferred for PR/release pip-audit. DeepCatalog uses embedded PersistentClient only (deepcatalog/chroma_local.py). Weekly scripts/chroma-advisory-watch.py runs without these ignores.

suppressions.summary: Pre-auth RCE / code injection in Chroma HTTP/FastAPI server (1.0.0–1.5.9).
suppressions.rationale: Affects Chroma's HTTP server surface. DeepCatalog never constructs HttpClient or starts a Chroma listener; it only uses chromadb.PersistentClient with RustBindingsAPI via deepcatalog.chroma_local.

suppressions.summary: GitHub advisory alias for CVE-2026-45829 (Chroma HTTP server).
suppressions.rationale: Same HTTP-server RCE as PYSEC-2026-311. pip-audit may report either ID; both are suppressed with the same embedded-client compensating control.

suppressions.summary: Chroma HTTP/FastAPI server advisory in the 1.0.0–1.5.9 range.
suppressions.rationale: Server-mode advisory. DeepCatalog does not bind CHROMA_SERVER_* or use FastAPI/HttpClient; embedded PersistentClient only.

suppressions.summary: Chroma HTTP/FastAPI server advisory in the 1.0.0–1.5.9 range.
suppressions.rationale: Server-mode advisory. DeepCatalog does not expose Chroma over the network; vectors stay in data/chroma via PersistentClient.

suppressions.summary: Authenticated injection in Chroma HTTP/FastAPI server (1.0.0–1.5.9).
suppressions.rationale: Requires Chroma's HTTP API. DeepCatalog never starts that server and rejects chroma_api_impl FastAPI / server host-port settings at client construction.
